ship_node: optional - only needed if your Walmart setup requires specifying a fulfillment location on inventory updates
_note: Copy this file to walmart.json (matching the account key in catalog/stores.json) in this same directory, fill in real values, never commit it. No redirect_uri/policy IDs like eBay needs, and no consent flow to run - WalmartOAuthClient fetches a token automatically on first use. See ../README.md and bin/reconcile_daemon.dart.
